title: Ukrainian attacks on warehouses of Russia's largest online retailer Wildberries are affecting tens of thousands of small businesses that rely on the platform (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: Ukrainian attacks on warehouses of Russia's largest online retailer Wildberries are affecting tens of thousands of small businesses that rely on the platform — In the space of three weeks, Vasily Klimov's online shopping pick-up point in Moscow has gone from a healthy small business …
